query:
WITH 
            turns AS (
                UPDATE turns SET archived=TRUE where game_id=$1
                RETURNING *
            ), 
            plyer_turns AS (
                UPDATE player_turns SET archived=TRUE WHERE game_id=$1
                RETURNING *
            )
        INSERT INTO admin_logs (game_id, datetime, action) VALUES ($1, NOW(), 'Returned game top lobby') RETURNING *
